title: Agents
description: Subagent runs: how many, how long, how much, and of what kind.

targets.queryText: select cast(strftime('%s', date(ts,'unixepoch')) as integer) as time, count(distinct agent_id) as runs from messages where agent_id is not null and ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select cast(strftime('%s', date(ts,'unixepoch')) as integer) as time, count(distinct agent_id) as runs from messages where agent_id is not null and ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

targets.queryText: select coalesce(agent_type, 'unknown') as type, sum(cost_usd) as cost from message_costs where agent_id is not null and ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by type order by cost desc
targets.rawQueryText: select coalesce(agent_type, 'unknown') as type, sum(cost_usd) as cost from message_costs where agent_id is not null and ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by type order by cost desc

targets.queryText: select substr(agent_id,1,8) as agent, coalesce(agent_type,'unknown') as type, model, count(*) as messages, round(sum(cost_usd),2) as cost_usd, round((max(ts)-min(ts))/60.0,1) as minutes, datetime(max(ts),'unixepoch') as last from message_costs where agent_id is not null and ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by agent_id order by max(ts) desc limit 25
targets.rawQueryText: select substr(agent_id,1,8) as agent, coalesce(agent_type,'unknown') as type, model, count(*) as messages, round(sum(cost_usd),2) as cost_usd, round((max(ts)-min(ts))/60.0,1) as minutes, datetime(max(ts),'unixepoch') as last from message_costs where agent_id is not null and ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by agent_id order by max(ts) desc limit 25
